_what: Identifiers that once existed in this tree, are gone now, and whose removing commit never said so. Recorded here so the gate reports only what is NEW. Recording is cheap; the point is that a loss stops being SILENT.
_how_to_read: An entry is not an excuse. Each one is either a deliberate refactor (fine) or an OPEN regression with a task (not fine, but at least visible). The second kind must name its task.

accepted.walletsCache: OPEN REGRESSION, task #63. The Wallet Standard picker, added 2026-07-23 in f517f3e and refined 2026-07-24 in bbca651, destroyed hours later by 9628c69, a commit about payer preflight that never mentions wallets.
